articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced a five-year compute donation valued at $250 million to strengthen the United Kingdom’s agentic safety and security research capability.
articles.fullSummary: News Summary: NVIDIA announces a compute donation valued at $250 million over five years to support U.K. agentic safety and security research. The program will support the wider U.K. research community, with a proportion of the commitment supporting BOLD, SOFAIR and Imperial College London across fundamental agentic foundation models and robotics safety.
